headline: 9 Solana addresses catalogued from official docs (program, mint, vault config, custodians, update-authority multisig, JUICED mint, USDC collateral mint); no on-chain reads possible.

findings.text: Solscan account pages (e.g. the update-authority multisig) failed to fetch, and no explorer name-tag search was possible. Solana is not among the read-API chainIds. Addresses come from the official docs only.

docs.jup.ag JupUSD page and developers.jup.ag Mint & Redeem page both have a 'Key addresses' table. Together they list mint, program, Anchorage and Coinbase custodian wallets, program buffer, update-authority multisig and Anchorage subaccount. The developer page also names the USDC vault config account. The JUICED page lists the JUICED mint.

The Offside Labs report (Dec 2025) was opened. It scopes the jup-stable and psm Anchor programs from github.com/jup-ag/jup-stablecoin at commit da2cd2b62d81b493f145fd0f81338a6cb5a973ed. It contains no deployed-address table. The Guardian and Pashov PDFs were linked in the docs but not opened.

The developer docs link github.com/jup-ag/jupusd-program (BSL licence), and the audit names github.com/jup-ag/jup-stablecoin. Neither repo was fetched, so no deployment artifacts were walked and no commit SHA was pinned.
Single chain (Solana). The 9 addresses come from the docs fetched in this run.
No factory contracts were identified. The program derives per-collateral vault PDAs (the USDC vault config is recorded). The USDtb vault address was not surfaced.
Roles were assigned from the doc labels using the controlled vocabulary. The leading token is kept and the suffix gives the doc label. actor_class is 'unknown' wherever no account data was read.
Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched docs.jup.ag, developers.jup.ag or jup.ag URL. Snippet-only sightings are in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Walked the docs.jup.ag and developers.jup.ag docs, the jup.ag homepage and the Offside Labs audit, and catalogued 9 Solana addresses. Explorer and GitHub walks were blocked, so no on-chain verification was done.

Offside Labs JupUSD smart contract security assessment, December 2025 (audit ran 8 Nov to 19 Dec 2025). Scope is the jup-stable and psm Anchor programs at github.com/jup-ag/jup-stablecoin, commit da2cd2b62d81b493f145fd0f81338a6cb5a973ed. Findings: 0 critical/high/medium, 2 low, 4 informational, all marked Fixed. No deployed-address table. It mentions admin, operator and pause roles in the program.
Website probe succeeded (Jupiter homepage, JS-disabled render). It confirms the USDC mint EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v. It lists no JupUSD-specific addresses.
Transparency page fetched, but only the meta header and logo rendered (JS app). No addresses or reserve data were extractable.

unknowns: D1-offchain: Solscan fetch for https://solscan.io/account/31wgH9Czzd3qgquTGxVxtxJuzBd8Fm4xEo8rPX7CNfhM failed ('URL could not be accessed'). No name-tag search or account-data read was possible. Solana is not a supported read-API chainId, so no surfacer pages exist.
D1: No explorer name-tag search was run for JupUSD. Two web searches returned only docs pages, not Solscan pages.
D2: docs.jup.ag/user-docs/earn/lend/program-addresses (Jupiter Lend programs, relevant to JUICED/JupUSD Earn) was not fetched. Jupiter Lend program and vault addresses are not catalogued.

D3: The Guardian (https://jupusd.money/homepage/audits/guardian.pdf) and Pashov (https://jupusd.money/homepage/audits/pashov.pdf) audits were not opened because the fetch budget ran out. Their scope addresses, dates and findings are unknown. They are not listed in protocol_metadata.audits.
D3: The Offside audit has no address table. It scopes the jup-stable and psm programs, so a separate PSM program and pool accounts may exist. No PSM program address was surfaced.

D4: The GitHub repos github.com/jup-ag/jupusd-program and github.com/jup-ag/jup-stablecoin were not fetched (the first was rejected by the fetch allowlist). No commit SHA is pinned, so no Anchor.toml, IDL, deployments or SDK constants were walked. The SDK package @jup-ag/jup-usd-sdk may hold config, vault and operator PDAs.
D5: chain Solana: addresses were surfaced only from the docs. No explorer data was read.

D6: Per-collateral vault PDAs, benefactor accounts and the operator/admin lists were not enumerated. The USDtb vault account and the USDtb mint address were not surfaced in fetched pages. The config PDA was not surfaced.

D7: actor_class for the custodian wallets, program buffer, vault config and Anchorage subaccount is 'unknown'. The account owner, authority and bytecode were not read. The 'multisig' label on 31wgH9Cz... comes from the docs only, and its Squads/threshold/signers are unverified.

D8: A search snippet of github.com/jup-ag/docs PR #988 (unmerged, third-party) says CkzLnD9r... is the program authority, owns the mint/redeem buffer, and is the JupUSD mint and freeze authority. That page was not fetched and the claim is not reflected in the role labels. It also says the mint/redeem vaults use one Pyth feed each, which conflicts with the developer docs' mention of Pyth, Chainlink and Chaos Labs. Pyth/Chainlink/Chaos Labs oracle feed addresses were not surfaced.

D8: A search snippet from jup.ag/tokens lists a different 'JupUSD' mint (CD5rmaHFgWJXGnBuhGnhHLrbjeFVoGpKj6tc1HMCjupx). It conflicts with the docs' mint JuprjznTr...USD. That page was not fetched and its provenance is unverified, so it is excluded from admin_addresses. Downstream slices should confirm the canonical mint on-chain.

D2: No governance forum, bug bounty page or security contact was found in the fetched pages. Upgradeability was not verified, and the program upgrade authority was not read. The docs only label 31wgH9Cz... 'update authority'.
D2: The jupusd.money/transparency page is JS-rendered and returned no reserve or address data. The Dune dashboard and api.jupusd.money were not fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: JupUSD is a Solana stablecoin built by Jupiter with Ethena. It is minted and redeemed 1:1 against USDC or USDtb collateral through a dedicated Solana program, and whitelisted KYC/KYB benefactors are the only direct minters and redeemers. Reserves are held with two custodians (Anchorage Digital and Coinbase Custody) and in an onchain program buffer, with a stated target mix of 90% USDtb and 10% USDC. Retail users get JupUSD by swapping. JupUSD itself earns no yield. Yield goes to JUICED, a vault-share token for JupUSD deposited in Jupiter Lend.
